claims.object_text: expression lower in gliomas; correlated with better prognosis
claims.quote: GNAO1 expression was lower in gliomas than in normal neuronal tissues and high expression of GNAO1 correlated with a better prognosis.

claims.object_text: promotes neural differentiation of glioma stem-like cells
claims.quote: GNAO1 overexpression markedly promoted neural differentiation of GSCs

claims.object_text: decreases cell proliferation and colony formation
claims.quote: leading to decreased cell proliferation and colony formation.

claims.object_text: recruits TRIM21 and facilitates TRIM21-mediated ubiquitination
claims.quote: GNAO1 recruited TRIM21 and facilitated TRIM21-mediated ubiquitination.

claims.object_text: ubiquitination causes CREB degradation and reduces p300-mediated H3K27ac at the HES1 promoter
claims.quote: This ubiquitination resulted in the degradation of CREB and further reduced p300-mediated H3K27ac levels of the HES1 promoter.

claims.object_text: downregulates HES1 expression to reinforce neuronal differentiation
claims.quote: As a result, GNAO1 overexpression downregulated HES1 expression, which reinforced neuronal differentiation.

claims.object_text: orthotopic GSC xenografts treated with GNAO1 adenovirus show increased neuronal differentiation and reduced tumor cell proliferation
claims.quote: Treatment with GNAO1 adenovirus increased neuronal differentiation of tumor cells and reduced tumor cell proliferation in orthotopic GSC xenografts

claims.object_text: temozolomide enhances GNAO1 adenovirus effects and extends animal survival
claims.quote: temozolomide further enhanced GNAO1 adenovirus effects, resulting in extended animal survival.

claims.object_text: engineering GNAO1 overexpression to induce neural differentiation of GSCs as a potential therapy
claims.quote: Our study presents that engineering GNAO1 overexpression-inducing neural differentiation of GSCs is a potential therapy strategy via synergistic inhibition of malignant proliferation and chemotherapy resistance.
